column6: hard to say, wrongy cropped rep
column8: Not a push-up, and not counted. On the video you walk to the phone at the end of the set; the app was still counting and today refused it with "Keep your legs in the picture". Nothing in the counter changed: no reading I tried (torso angle, view) separates such moments from a real rep reliably yet, so they stay refused with words meant for a rep. The clip now runs 1:36.1–1:38.2 (it used to start at 1:35.0). "other" is the label for a moment that is not a push-up.
